message.content:
This appears to be a CBP ruling on an axle generator (speed sensor) for locomotives. The device is a magnetic or optical encoder that sends pulses to measure rotational speed. Candidate headings are 9029 (speed indicators and tachometers; parts and accessories) and 8537 or 8543. Heading 9029.20 covers speedometers and tachometers, and 9029.90 covers their parts and accessories.

I recall that the ruling classified the ZTR AxleGen as a part of a speedometer under 9029.90.8000 or 9029.90.0400. Under subheading 9029.90, the 8-digit lines are 9029.90.04 (parts and accessories of taximeters, etc.) and 9029.90.08 (other). At the 10-digit level, 9029.90.0400 reads "Parts and accessories: Of taximeters... " Hmm, I believe the statistical suffixes are 9029.90.0400 for "of the instruments of subheading 9029.10" and 9029.90.8000 for "Other". The other option, 9029.90.4000, I do not recall. Because the device is an accessory to the speed indicator, I will choose 9029.90.8000.

Since the AxleGen is a sensor feeding a speed indicator, it is best treated as a part or accessory of a speedometer in heading 9029.

{"hts_code": "9029.90.8000", "reason": "The axle generator is a sensor that sends pulses to a cab module that determines rotational speed, so it is a part or accessory of a speed indicator or tachometer of heading 9029."}
